measured_evidence.rule_adopted: presence may be reported as ARTIFACT_PRESENT and nothing stronger; execution evidence would require an execution record tied to a specific invocation

corrections.effect_on_artifacts: evidence class downgraded for those stages; no hash changes

measured_evidence.what_index_true_does: it keeps the pandas index as parquet metadata; the index values are whatever the frame carried, which for a JQ get_price frame is typically a (time, code) multi-index, not an integer ordinal
measured_evidence.what_is_not_admitted: no malformed-date or integer-date cause is inferred from index=True
measured_evidence.residual_observation_kept: that writer requests neither 'code' nor 'time' as fields, so the date and code axes live only in the index; that observation stands on its own without the stronger causal claim
